levels.surface: محمد بن عمرو بن حلحلة الدؤلي

notes: «حدثنا أبي أن الوليد بن كثير» gives a bare relation (rule 7). «أن علي بن حسين حدثه أنهم» ends the chain at Ali b. Husayn's account; the Companion who speaks in it, al-Miswar, is the last link (he relays the Prophet's words on Fatima).
Ali b. Husayn and al-Miswar speak inside the story; the report's transmitters are read in text order. The Prophet's speech is the end of the saying, not a link.
